title: COLD-RESECT
summary:
Endoscopic ablation of small bowel polyps with "cold" (without cutting current) or "hot" (with cutting current) snare.
Active treatment data collection -treatment arms randomly distributed - 1:1

interventions.name:
"cold snare"

Cold snare ablation compared to conventional hot snare resection of
polyps between 20 mm and 50 mm longitudinal diameter and up to 2/3 of circumference

"hot snare"

Cold snare ablation compared to conventional hot snare resection of
polyps between 20 mm and 50 mm longitudinal diameter and up to 2/3 of circumference

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Non-ampullary, sporadic duodenal adenomas with a size between 20 and 50 mm longitudinal diameter or occupying up to a maximum of 2/3 of the circumference (longitudinal extension max 5 cm). The diameter is measured with an opened loop of known size
Exclusion criteria:
- Recurrent adenomas or adenomas after previous intervention
- Existing pregnancy
- ASA > III
- Tumor disease without curative therapy option
- Coagulation disorders /patients under dual platelet aggregation inhibition
- Lesions that are macroscopically suspicious of an existing an existing submucosal invasion
- Patients not capable of explanation
